content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Colonial stonework and gilded altars tell Cusco's layered story."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cacao from bean to bar, with a chance to taste the good stuff."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Under Inti (the sun)'s farewell, the dome brings the southern stars close."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The salt pans shimmer like a thousand tiny mirrors under Inti (the sun)."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Those circular terraces feel like a giant's amphitheatre carved into the earth."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view that makes you feel small in the best way."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A riot of colours, fruit juices and Andean chatter under one roof."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold, textiles and stories of the Inca world, all under one old roof."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Cobbled lanes, tiny workshops and balconies that lean in to gossip."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with Inca and colonial stories, and the mountains watch over every step."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The temple walls still hold the memory of Inti (the sun), with stonework so precise it feels alive."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A white guardian above the city, where the rooftops and hills unfold like a welcome."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A plant-based table that proves Cusco can be kind to every appetite."}]}
A whole Cusco arc, from first steps to market farewell, and every must-do tucked in.
